example: Lesley is a volunteer for community service in this town. John volunteered to repair the car for the old lady.
example_zh: 萊斯利是這個鎮裡的社區服務志工。約翰志願替老太太修汽車。
chinese: 志願者；義工；志願；志願提供
memory_hint: volunt 表「意志、志願」，-eer 表「者」，合起來引申為「志願者」。

example: The union staged a walkout for better work conditions.
example_zh: 工會為爭取更好的工作條件而罷工。
memory_hint: walk 表「走」，out 表「外面」，合起來引申為「離去、罷工」。

example: Be happy because the moon will become full after it wanes.
example_zh: 高興點！月缺以後才會有月圓。
memory_hint: wane 表逐漸減少、衰弱；三態 wane, waned, waned。

example: Please put your waste in the dustbin. Please turn the tap off, and don't waste water.
example_zh: 請把你的廢棄物扔進垃圾桶裡。請關水龍頭，別浪費水。
memory_hint: waste 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 waste, wasted, wasted，名詞複數 wastes。

example: My brown jacket is for everyday wear. He was wearing a gold ring.
example_zh: 這是我每天心穿的棕色夾克。他戴著一個金戒指。
memory_hint: wear 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 wear, wore, worn。

example: Can the students read the weather chart?
example_zh: 這些學生能看懂氣象圖嗎？
memory_hint: 常見搭配有 forecast the weather、fair weather。

example: These old people are living on welfare now.
example_zh: 這些老人現在靠社會福利生活。
memory_hint: well 表「很好地」，fare 表「飲食」，合起來引申為「福利」；child welfare 指兒童福利，social welfare 指社會福利。

example: Does Judy buy the goods at wholesale or retail? The wholesale prices of these shoes are 32 dollars.
example_zh: 這批貨朱蒂是整批買還是零買？這些鞋子的批發價是三十二美元。
memory_hint: whole 表「整體的」，sale 表「銷售」，合起來引申為「批發」。

example: During wind tunnel tests on the car, at the development stage, water was added.
example_zh: 對汽車進行風洞測試期間（也就是開發階段時），要添加水。
memory_hint: wind 表「風」，tunnel 表「隧道」，合起來就是「風洞」。

example: There is a great deal of friction between the management and the work force.
example_zh: 管理階層與勞工之間有很大的爭執。
memory_hint: work 表「勞動」，force 表「力」，合起來引申為「勞動力、受雇用的人」。

example: Some of my friends said to me that Robert was very worldly.
example_zh: 我的一些朋友對我說，羅伯特非常世故。
memory_hint: worldly 的比較級為 worldlier，最高級為 worldliest。

example: The salesman seems very zealous in his work.
example_zh: 這位推銷員看來非常熱心於他的工作。
memory_hint: zeal 表「熱心」，-ous 表「有…特質的」，合起來引申為「熱心的、熱情的」。

example: A man who always likes to use bad language will only abase himself.
example_zh: 總喜歡說髒話的人只會自貶身分。
memory_hint: ab + base，可聯想為「使降低、使謙卑」。

example: The old abbey ruins looked so horrible at midnight that they dared not approach it.
example_zh: 古修道院的廢墟在深夜看起來很恐怖，所以他們不敢接近。
memory_hint: abbey 指修道院或大教堂。

example: UN is abbreviated from United Nations.
example_zh: UN 是 United Nations（聯合國）的縮寫。
memory_hint: abbreviate 表縮寫、縮短。

example: She abdicated her responsibilities for the care of the child.
example_zh: 她放棄了照顧孩子的責任。
memory_hint: abdicate 表辭去職位或放棄責任。

example: She always feels great pain in her abdomen so she decided to go to hospital this weekend.
example_zh: 她總是感到腹部疼痛，所以她決定這個週末去醫院。
memory_hint: abdomen 指腹部。

example: Most people abhor violence.
example_zh: 大多數人憎恨暴力。
memory_hint: abhor 表強烈憎惡。

example: She cannot abide the pressure anymore.
example_zh: 她再也無法忍受這麼大的壓力。
memory_hint: abide 可表示忍受，也可表示停留。

example: He is an abject coward.
example_zh: 他是個極可憐的懦夫。
memory_hint: abject 指卑屈、悲慘或可憐的。

example: People appealed for abolishing official policies of racial segregation.
example_zh: 人們呼籲廢除官方的種族隔離政策。
memory_hint: abolish 表正式廢除制度、法律或政策。

example: They are looking for a dragoman who knows the aboriginal language.
example_zh: 他們在尋找一個懂得土著語言的譯員。
memory_hint: aboriginal 表原住民的、原始的。

example: He married an aborigine which surprised his family.
example_zh: 他娶了一個原住民，這讓他的家人很吃驚。
memory_hint: aborigine 指原住民。

example: She thinks those who have abortions will not be able to go to heaven.
example_zh: 她認為那些進行流產的人不能去天堂。
memory_hint: abortion 指流產或墮胎。

example: The island abounds with snakes so you must be very careful.
example_zh: 那個島上有很多蛇，你一定要小心。
memory_hint: abound with 表大量存在。

example: These materials have strong abrasive resistance.
example_zh: 這些材料耐磨力強。
memory_hint: abrasive 可指研磨的、磨蝕的。

example: The abrupt change in her life gave her lots of trouble and it took a long time to get used to it.
example_zh: 生活中突然而來的變化帶給她很多麻煩，她過了很長一段時間才適應。
memory_hint: abrupt 表突然的或唐突的。

example: That oenophilist swore to abstain from drinking.
example_zh: 那個嗜酒的人發誓要戒酒。
memory_hint: abstain from 表戒絕、避免。

example: One of my good friends is an abstemious person.
example_zh: 我的一個好朋友是個節制的人。
memory_hint: abstemious 指飲食或生活節制的。

example: Total abstinence is essential to his health.
example_zh: 完全戒酒對他的健康至關重要。
memory_hint: abstinence 指戒絕，尤其指戒酒。

example: Many students thought that the professor's lectures were a bit too abstruse.
example_zh: 許多學生都認為這個教授的課很難理解。
memory_hint: abstruse 指難理解、深奧的。

example: You should not use abusive or obscene language to criticize others.
example_zh: 你們不應該用罵人的或不流的話來批評他人。
memory_hint: abusive 指辱罵的或濫用的。

example: The government decided to take a policy to accelerate economical recovery.
example_zh: 政府決定採取措施以加速經濟復元。
memory_hint: accelerate 表加速、促進。

example: The place is accessible only by boat.
example_zh: 這個地方只有坐船才能到達。
memory_hint: accessible 指可到達、可使用的。

example: All their motorcycle accessories are not only brand new but also of the best quality.
example_zh: 他們所有的摩托車附件不僅是全新的，而且品質也是最好的。
memory_hint: accessory 可指附件，也可指從犯。

example: People acclaimed him president.
example_zh: 人們推立他為總統。
memory_hint: acclaim 表歡呼、稱讚或推舉。

example: I have not become acclimated to Taiwan yet.
example_zh: 我還不能適應台灣的環境。
memory_hint: acclimate 表使適應氣候或環境。

example: To be chosen to represent his country is the highest accolade for an athlete.
example_zh: 能被選拔出來代表國家，是一個運動員的最高嘉獎。
memory_hint: accolade 指嘉獎、讚譽。

example: He was accused as an accomplice.
example_zh: 他被指控為同謀。
memory_hint: accomplice 指共犯、同謀。

example: Both his parents are accomplished musicians but he knows nothing about music.
example_zh: 他父母都是有造詣的音樂家，但他卻對音樂一竅不通。
chinese: 完成了的；熟練的；有造詣的
memory_hint: accomplished 可指完成的，也可指技藝熟練的。

example: The manager had told you the details so you should act accordingly.
example_zh: 經理已經告訴你細節了，所以你應該照著做。
memory_hint: accordingly 表照著、因此。

example: Every employee is accountable for his work so if you can't finish your task on time you should work overtime.
example_zh: 每個員工都要對自己的工作負責，如果你不能準時完成任務，就應該加班。
chinese: 有解釋義務的；應負責任的
memory_hint: accountable for 表對…負責。

example: Interest will accrue if you keep your money in the savings bank.
example_zh: 如果你把錢存在銀行裡就會生利息。
memory_hint: accrue 指利益、利息等逐漸產生。

example: She has successfully accumulated a fortune to buy an apartment.
example_zh: 她已經成功累積一筆錢買公寓。
memory_hint: accumulate 表累積、積聚。

example: The accusation was that she had murdered her husband.
example_zh: 罪名是她謀殺了丈夫。
memory_hint: accusation 指指控、罪名。

example: The article is about a man who is an ace at chess.
example_zh: 這篇文章是關於一個西洋棋高手。
memory_hint: ace 可指一流高手。

example: His acid look hurt me deeply.
example_zh: 他尖酸刻薄的眼神深深傷害了我。
memory_hint: acid 作形容詞可指酸的或尖酸刻薄的。

example: Her acidulous satire made me very angry.
example_zh: 她那刻薄的諷刺讓我非常生氣。
memory_hint: acidulous 指帶酸味或尖酸諷刺的。

example: He was in the acme of happiness.
example_zh: 他快樂到了頂點。
memory_hint: acme 指最高點、極點。

example: How can an acne-scarred man be a model?
example_zh: 一個滿臉粉刺的人怎麼可以當模特兒？
memory_hint: acne 指粉刺、痤瘡。

example: There are many acorns on the oak tree.
example_zh: 這棵橡樹上有很多橡子。
memory_hint: acorn 指橡樹的果實。

example: She found a part-time job in order to save money to buy an acoustic guitar.
example_zh: 她找了一份兼職工作，為的是存錢買原音吉他。
memory_hint: acoustic 與聲音、聽覺有關。

example: Don't worry; the burglar alarm was activated by mistake.
example_zh: 別擔心；防盜鈴是被不小心啟動了。
memory_hint: activate 表使啟動、使活化。

example: The two men who live on adjacent streets never communicate with each other.
example_zh: 這兩個住在相鄰街道的人從不來往。
memory_hint: adjacent 表相鄰、鄰近的。

example: His father who was a fleet admiral died in the war.
example_zh: 他的父親是個艦隊司令，但在戰爭中殉職了。
chinese: 海軍上將；海軍將官；艦隊司令
memory_hint: admiral 指海軍高階將領。

example: Since the advent of the computer, there have been great changes in the world.
example_zh: 自從電腦問世以來，世界發生了巨大的變化。
memory_hint: advent 指出現、到來。

example: He is adverse to violence so he won't agree with our plan.
example_zh: 他反對暴力，所以不會同意我們的計畫。
memory_hint: adverse 表不利的、相反的；be adverse to 表反對。

example: I will offer an advisory opinion but you'd better make your own decision.
example_zh: 我將提供忠告的意見，但你們最好自己做決定。
memory_hint: advisory 指顧問性、勸告性的。

example: Young people love this film for there are lots of aerial action in it.
example_zh: 年輕人喜歡這部電影是因為裡面有很多空中特技。
memory_hint: aerial 指空中的、航空的。

example: I think a film should have both aesthetic and commercial value.
example_zh: 我認為一部電影應該具有審美和商業價值。
memory_hint: aesthetic 指美學的、審美的。

example: Her treatise on aesthetics earned her a scholarship so that there was no need to find part-time jobs.
example_zh: 她在美學方面的論文為她贏得了獎學金，所以不再需要找兼職工作。
memory_hint: aesthetics 指美學。

example: The audience was greatly moved by her affectionate speech about love.
example_zh: 她關於愛的演講感情真摯，深深地打動了觀眾。
memory_hint: affectionate 指充滿感情、親切的。

example: She graduated from a college affiliated with the church.
example_zh: 她從一所隸屬於教堂的大學畢業。
memory_hint: affiliate with 表與…有隸屬或聯繫關係。

example: We should help those who are afflicted with cancer.
example_zh: 我們應該幫助那些受癌症折磨的人。
memory_hint: afflict with 表使受…折磨。

example: The economy recovered and life was more comfortable in the aftermath of war.
example_zh: 戰爭過後的時期，經濟復甦，人們的生活也更舒適。
chinese: 後果；某事情結束後的一段時期
memory_hint: aftermath 指事件後果或事後時期。

example: She became quite agitated when she was asked about her past.
example_zh: 當被問到她的過去時，她變得很焦躁不安。
memory_hint: agitate 表煽動、鼓動或使焦躁。

example: The workers were in great agitation after hearing the speech.
example_zh: 工人們聽完演講之後，情緒非常激動。
memory_hint: agitation 是 agitate 的名詞，表示激動、騷動。

example: She was in agony with great remorse after she knew she had misunderstood him.
example_zh: 她在得知誤解了他之後，就處於悔恨的痛苦之中。
memory_hint: agony 指極度的痛苦或苦惱。

example: The president has sent his aide, the one he trusts most, to solve the problem.
example_zh: 董事長已經派他的助手，也是他最信任的人，去解決那個問題。
memory_hint: aide 指助手、助理或副官。

example: It sounds like an airtight excuse but I don't believe you.
example_zh: 這聽起來像是個無懈可擊的藉口，但我不相信你。
memory_hint: airtight 可指密封的，也可比喻無懈可擊的。

example: If there is any algebra problem that you can't figure out, you can ask your brother.
example_zh: 如果你有任何代數問題算不出來，你可以問你哥哥。
memory_hint: algebra 指代數學。

example: She kept telling lies which alienated her friends.
example_zh: 她不停地撒謊，這使她的朋友疏遠了她。
memory_hint: alienate 表使疏遠、離間。

example: He made a serious allegation without any evidence of its truth.
example_zh: 他做出重要的斷言，卻沒有任何事實的根據。
memory_hint: allegation 指未經證實的主張或指控。

example: The woman alleged that her husband was murdered but she had no evidence.
example_zh: 那個女人宣稱她丈夫是被謀殺的，但她沒有證據。
memory_hint: allege 表宣稱、斷言，常指尚未證實。
